runs.title: Agentic AI Deployment Review
runs.environment: AWS GovCloud pilot-target (maps-toward FedRAMP High controls — not authorized)
runs.nistProfile: NIST AI RMF Govern / Map / Measure / Manage
runs.summary: Pre-production gate for a retrieval-augmented claims assistant with external action groups, policy memory, and audit-grade approval controls.

agents.name: Planner
agents.output: Mapped 6 review tasks and routed policy, security, and cost checks.

agents.name: Security Reviewer
agents.output: Flagged external API action group until scoped approval and egress policy are attached.

agents.name: Compliance Analyst
agents.output: Mapped 14 controls and requested evidence for logging retention and human override.

agents.name: Cost Analyst
agents.output: Projected operating cost remains inside policy budget with model fallback capped.

agents.name: Evidence Builder
agents.output: Building signed evidence packet with reviewer approval attached.

approvalGate.title: Enable external API action group
approvalGate.reason: The agent wants write-capable tool access to a benefits API. Scope, audit, and rollback policy must be confirmed before activation.

risks.label: PII leakage
risks.evidence: Redaction policy and retrieval allowlist required before pilot.

risks.label: Prompt injection
risks.evidence: Adversarial retrieval tests found two unsafe instruction-following attempts.

risks.label: Unsafe tool use
risks.evidence: Reviewer approved scoped action group with egress allowlist and rollback playbook.

risks.label: Audit gaps
risks.evidence: Trace ID exists, retention and reviewer signature are missing.

risks.label: Cost drift
risks.evidence: Fallback model use spikes when retrieval confidence drops below 0.72.

events: Approved: Enable external API action group by Grant Burley III as security-reviewer.
Policy pass: Proceed with controlled pilot boundary.
Assessment 02 opened from SentinelOps API service.
Planner opened deployment review and assigned specialist agents.
Security Reviewer blocked external action group until approval.
Compliance Analyst mapped risks to NIST AI RMF functions.
Cost Analyst began fallback model budget review.

policyChecks.policyName: External Action Group Controlled Pilot Policy

checks.label: Scoped service account
Outbound egress allowlist
Rollback playbook
Tool call audit retention
Reviewer identity attached to approval decision
Approval decision links to active trace ID
Critical unsafe-tool risk cannot bypass gate
Gate decisions require reviewer identity, reviewer role, and explicit state.
checks.remediation: Resolve the reviewer from trusted auth context before mutating the gate.

checks.label: Gate decision must remain linked to run, trace, and approval gate identifiers.
checks.remediation: Reject decisions that cannot be tied to the current run trace and gate ID.

checks.label: Controlled pilot approval requires complete action-group evidence.
checks.remediation: Attach scoped service account, egress allowlist, rollback, and audit-retention evidence before approval.

checks.label: Persisted gate state must match the reviewer decision.
checks.remediation: Abort the transition when the persisted gate state diverges from the reviewer decision.
